papers.title: Learning curves in robotic and laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a systematic review
papers.authors: Nocera F, Wiedemann F, Müller P, Billeter A, Angehrn F, Müller B
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare learning-curve assessment in laparoscopic and robotic colorectal surgery and to develop a standardized framework for future learning-curve reporting.
BACKGROUND: Learning curves in minimally invasive colorectal surgery are widely reported, but inconsistent definitions limit interpretability and comparability. This systematic review analyzed learning-curve assessment in laparoscopic and robotic colorectal surgery and proposes a standardized framework.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Web of Science, and CENTRAL were systematically searched according to PRISMA guidelines (registered in PROSPERO, CRD42026128860). Included were randomized, prospective, and retrospective studies on learning curves in colorectal surgery. Primary outcome was the number of procedures required to reach the initial learning phase. Secondary outcomes included definitions of learning curves, analytical methods, and classification of learning phases. Analyses were stratified by procedure type (colon vs. rectal resections), and pooled breakpoint regression was used to identify learning phases.
RESULTS: A total of 114 studies comprising 167 learning-curve analyses were included. CUSUM or risk-adjusted CUSUM was used in 66.4% of analyses, whereas 33.3% applied arbitrary definitions; operative time was the most frequently used endpoint (79.6%). Operative-time plateaus were identified after 38 colonic and 56 rectal procedures. Reported median competency thresholds were numerically lower for robotic than laparoscopic surgery in colonic resections (24 vs. 30 cases; p = 0.659) and rectal resections (28 vs. 38 cases; p = 0.140), but these differences were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: Learning-curve assessment in minimally invasive colorectal surgery remains heterogeneous. Robotic series report numerically lower competency thresholds than laparoscopic series; however, this likely reflects skill transfer from prior laparoscopic experience and modern training pathways rather than an intrinsically shorter learning curve of the robotic platform. Differences in prior surgeon experience, training, and study era limit direct comparison. Standardized assessment and prospective studies with comparable baseline exposure are needed.

papers.title_zh: 機器手臂與腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術學習曲線之系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：評估並比較腹腔鏡與機器手臂大腸直腸手術學習曲線的評估方式，並建立未來學習曲線報告之標準化框架。
背景：微創大腸直腸手術的學習曲線已被廣泛報告，但定義不一致限制了可解讀性與可比性。本系統性回顧分析腹腔鏡與機器手臂大腸直腸手術的學習曲線評估方式，並提出標準化框架。
方法：依PRISMA準則系統性搜尋MEDLINE、Web of Science與CENTRAL（已於PROSPERO註冊，編號CRD42026128860）。納入隨機、前瞻性與回溯性學習曲線相關研究。主要結果為達到初始學習階段所需手術例數。次要結果包括學習曲線定義、分析方法與學習階段分類。分析依手術類型（結腸 vs 直腸切除）分層，並使用合併斷點迴歸（pooled breakpoint regression）界定學習階段。
結果：共納入114篇研究，包含167筆學習曲線分析。66.4%的分析使用CUSUM或風險校正CUSUM，33.3%使用武斷定義；手術時間是最常用的終點指標（79.6%）。手術時間平台期在結腸切除38例、直腸切除56例後出現。報告的勝任門檻中位數，機器手臂在結腸切除（24 vs 30例；p=0.659）與直腸切除（28 vs 38例；p=0.140）均在數字上低於腹腔鏡，但這些差異未達統計顯著。
結論：微創大腸直腸手術的學習曲線評估仍高度異質。機器手臂系列報告的勝任門檻在數字上低於腹腔鏡系列，然而此現象更可能反映先前腹腔鏡經驗的技能轉移與現代訓練路徑，而非機器手臂平台本身具有較短的學習曲線。先前手術經驗、訓練方式與研究年代的差異限制了直接比較。仍需標準化評估方式與基線暴露相當的前瞻性研究。
papers.score_reason: 方法學異質性高（定義、終點不一），且主要結論（機器手臂與腹腔鏡學習曲線無顯著差異）未達統計顯著，對臨床決策直接影響有限，但對訓練規劃有參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 此文聚焦訓練/教育面向的學習曲線方法學，而非直接病人臨床結果，較適合訓練計畫擬定者參考。
papers.one_liner: 整合114篇研究167筆學習曲線分析，比較機器手臂與腹腔鏡勝任門檻，結腸24 vs 30例（p=0.659）、直腸28 vs 38例（p=0.140），均未達顯著差異。
papers.action: 目前不需改變臨床做法；可作為新進主治醫師訓練規劃參考，但機器手臂「學習曲線較短」此說法缺乏統計支持，勿過度宣稱。

papers.title: Malignancy in patients with acromegaly: a multicenter study across the Gulf region
papers.authors: AlDahmani K, Mahzari M, Elhadd T, Aziz F, Ekhzaimy A, Jaber T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Chronic growth hormone and insulin-like growth factor 1 excess may promote tumorigenesis, but the magnitude of malignancy risk in acromegaly remains uncertain and regional data from the Gulf are limited.
OBJECTIVE: To describe the frequency, spectrum, detection, outcomes, and clinical correlates of malignancy among patients with acromegaly treated across Gulf tertiary centers.
DESIGN: Multicenter retrospective observational study.
SETTING: Five tertiary centers across Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: Medical records of patients aged >16 years with acromegaly who were evaluated from 2010 through 2024 were reviewed. Demographic, disease, treatment, cancer-testing, and malignancy data were collected. Group comparisons were descriptive and exploratory because only 10 malignancies occurred.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Documented malignancy frequency, cancer type, method of detection, stage, treatment, outcome, and clinical correlates.
SAMPLE SIZE: 157 patients.
RESULTS: The mean age was 47.1 years, 101 patients (64.3%) were male, and the mean disease duration was 9.4 years. Malignancy was documented in 10 patients (6.4%), most commonly papillary thyroid carcinoma (8/10). Two of the eight papillary thyroid carcinomas were classified as T1a (≤10 mm); exact pathology measurements were not consistently available. One patient had colorectal cancer, and one had prostate cancer. Exploratory comparisons showed that patients with malignancy were older than those without malignancy (mean age, 56.6 vs 46.5 years; P=.039). The remaining comparisons were inconclusive. All patients with malignancy were in remission or had an excellent response at the last documented follow-up.
CONCLUSION: Malignancy was documented in 6.4% (10 out of 157) in this multi-center Gulf acromegaly cohort, predominantly papillary thyroid carcinoma. The findings support individualized surveillance based on population guidance, symptoms, family history, and clinical findings rather than an acromegaly-specific screening program.
LIMITATIONS: Retrospective design, small number of malignancy events, missing data, lack of a population comparator, and nonstandardized cancer testing may introduce selection and detection biases.
papers.title_zh: 肢端肥大症患者之惡性腫瘤：波斯灣地區多中心研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：長期生長激素與類胰島素生長因子1過量可能促進腫瘤生成，但肢端肥大症患者惡性腫瘤風險的程度仍不確定，且波斯灣地區的區域性資料有限。目的：描述波斯灣三級醫療中心肢端肥大症患者中惡性腫瘤的發生率、種類、偵測方式、預後及臨床相關因子。設計：多中心回溯性觀察研究。場所：沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、阿拉伯聯合大公國共五個三級醫療中心。病人與方法：回顧2010年至2024年間年齡大於16歲、經評估確診肢端肥大症之病人病歷。收集人口學、疾病、治療、癌症篩檢及惡性腫瘤相關資料。因僅發生10例惡性腫瘤，組間比較僅為描述性與探索性。主要結果指標：記錄之惡性腫瘤發生率、癌症類型、偵測方式、分期、治療及預後、臨床相關因子。樣本數：157名病人。結果：平均年齡47.1歲，101名（64.3%）為男性，平均病程9.4年。10名病人（6.4%）被記錄有惡性腫瘤，最常見為甲狀腺乳突癌（8/10）。8例甲狀腺乳突癌中有2例分類為T1a（≤10mm）；確切病理測量值並非一致可得。1名病人有大腸直腸癌，1名有攝護腺癌。探索性比較顯示有惡性腫瘤之病人較無惡性腫瘤者年長（平均年齡56.6歲 vs 46.5歲；P=.039）。其餘比較結果不具決定性。所有惡性腫瘤病人於最後一次記錄追蹤時皆已緩解或反應極佳。結論：此波斯灣多中心肢端肥大症世代中，6.4%（10/157）病人被記錄有惡性腫瘤，以甲狀腺乳突癌為主。研究結果支持依據族群指引、症狀、家族史及臨床發現進行個別化監測，而非肢端肥大症專屬之篩檢計畫。限制：回溯性設計、惡性腫瘤事件數少、資料缺失、缺乏族群對照組、以及非標準化的癌症檢測，可能引入選擇性與偵測性偏誤。
papers.score_reason: 樣本小、事件數僅10例、無族群對照組，且與大腸直腸外科實務幾乎無直接關聯（僅1例CRC），對臨床決策參考價值低。
papers.relevance_why: 本研究主題為內分泌科肢端肥大症患者之整體惡性腫瘤監測，非大腸直腸手術介入，且CRC僅佔1/10案例。

papers.title: Spatial multi-omics-guided drug development in inflammatory bowel disease: from mucosal immune niches to precision therapy
papers.authors: Wang H, Zhao X, Yang J
papers.abstract: Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis are now treated with an expanding set of biologics and small molecules, yet treatment selection remains largely empirical. Primary non-response, secondary loss of response, incomplete mucosal healing, fibrostenosis, and fistulizing disease show that conventional clinical, endoscopic, and bulk molecular markers do not capture how disease is organized within tissue. This review argues that the inflamed intestine is better viewed as a set of spatially structured mucosal immune niches rather than as uniform inflammation, with epithelial, myeloid, lymphoid, stromal, vascular, neural, and microbiome-associated cells communicating through defined cytokine and ligand-receptor circuits. In this framework, mucosal immune niches can be considered functional tissue units that link tissue-resolved mechanisms to therapeutic target discovery, pharmacodynamic assessment, biomarker qualification, and biomarker-enriched trial design. Single-cell atlases and spatial multi-omics, interpreted through computational modeling, can identify disease-driving cellular neighborhoods, ligand-receptor circuits, and compartment-specific vulnerabilities in both diseases. We discuss how these spatial features may inform target discovery, mechanism-of-action validation, patient stratification, response prediction, and trial design, using pathways such as TNF, IL-23, OSM, TL1A, integrins, JAK-STAT, and S1P as examples. At present, the realistic value of spatial data lies in generating mechanistic hypotheses, defining pharmacodynamic endpoints, and enriching trials, not in guiding routine treatment selection. Most candidate spatial biomarkers remain at the discovery or early translational stage and require standardized sampling, harmonized computation, longitudinal assessment, and multicenter validation. A staged translational path is proposed, moving from disease-specific atlases to spatial pharmacodynamic endpoints and adaptive precision trials, while also offering a comparative framework for studying chronic inflammation across mucosal organs.

papers.title_zh: 空間多體學引導之發炎性腸道疾病藥物開發：從黏膜免疫微環境到精準治療
papers.abstract_zh: 克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎目前可用的生物製劑與小分子藥物種類日益增多，但治療選擇仍大致仰賴經驗。原發性無反應、續發性反應喪失、黏膜癒合不完全、纖維化狹窄與廔管形成等現象顯示，傳統臨床、內視鏡與整體（bulk）分子標記無法捕捉疾病在組織內的空間組織方式。本綜述主張，發炎的腸道更適合被視為一組空間結構化的黏膜免疫微環境（niche），而非均質性發炎，其中上皮、骨髓、淋巴、基質、血管、神經與微生物相關細胞透過特定的細胞激素與配體-受體迴路相互溝通。在此架構下，黏膜免疫微環境可視為功能性組織單位，將組織層級的機轉與治療標的發現、藥效學評估、生物標記鑑定及生物標記富集化試驗設計連結起來。單細胞圖譜與空間多體學經由計算模型解讀後，可辨識兩種疾病中驅動疾病的細胞鄰域、配體-受體迴路及區室特異性弱點。本文討論這些空間特徵如何為標的發現、作用機轉驗證、病人分層、反應預測及試驗設計提供資訊，並以TNF、IL-23、OSM、TL1A、整合素（integrins）、JAK-STAT與S1P等路徑為例說明。目前，空間資料的實際價值在於產生機轉假說、定義藥效學終點及富集試驗族群，而非指導常規治療選擇。大多數候選空間生物標記仍處於發現或早期轉譯階段，需要標準化取樣、統一化計算方法、縱向評估及多中心驗證。本文提出一條分階段轉譯路徑，從疾病特異性圖譜進展至空間藥效學終點與適應性精準試驗，同時也為研究黏膜器官間慢性發炎提供比較性架構。

papers.title: Progress on the regulation of colorectal cancer and cardio-oncology by the gut microbiota and nutrients
papers.authors: Liu A, Tan R, Zhou X, Wang P, Wang X
papers.abstract: As one of the most common malignant tumors worldwide, the pathogenesis of colorectal cancer (CRC) was complex. Recent studies have revealed that dysbiosis of the gut microbiota and abnormal nutritional metabolism played a key role in the occurrence and development of tumors. With the rapid development of cardio-oncology, the cardiovascular toxicity risks faced by CRC patients during radiotherapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy have become increasingly prominent, emerging as a key factor affecting long-term patient outcomes. However, there was currently a lack of systematic integration regarding the mechanisms underlying the interplay between the gut microbiota, nutritional interventions, and cardio-oncology in the management of CRC. This article aims to review the mechanisms underlying the interaction between CRC and the gut microbiota, the effects of nutritional interventions on the gut microbiota and tumor progression, and the important role of cardio-oncology in the treatment of CRC. This review examines the emerging evidence on how gut microbiota and nutrition interact to influence CRC development, progression, and therapeutic response, and proposes a theoretical basis for integrating these insights into multidisciplinary comprehensive treatment strategies.

papers.title: Neutrophil extracellular traps in colorectal cancer: a paradoxical nexus of tumor defense and disease progression
papers.authors: Ge Y, Kong W, Qian Y, Sun Y, Zhu G, Li J
papers.abstract: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are extracellular networks of decondensed chromatin and granular proteins generated by neutrophils in response to activating stimuli. Growing evidence indicates that NETs participate in colorectal cancer (CRC) development through their interactions with chronic inflammation, immune regulation, coagulation, and tumor progression. However, their biological effects vary across disease settings, and the regulatory mechanisms specific to CRC have not been fully clarified. This review examines the roles of NETs at different stages of CRC, including the transition from inflammation to cancer, primary tumor growth, metastatic spread, treatment resistance, and CRC-associated complications. We discuss CRC-related mechanisms of NET formation involving tumor-derived chemokines, stromal cells, microbial dysbiosis, oncogenic signals, and ROS-dependent pathways. Available evidence also suggests that NETs are not uniformly pro-tumorigenic. We therefore describe a "paradoxical nexus" in which their effects depend on tumor genotype, neutrophil phenotype, immune context, and the stimulus inducing NET formation. In addition, we review NET-related biomarkers, detection methods, and therapeutic approaches, while considering the evidence required for their clinical application and for context-specific treatment of CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 嗜中性球胞外誘捕網（NETs）是嗜中性球在受刺激活化後產生的去凝縮染色質與顆粒蛋白所構成的細胞外網狀結構。愈來愈多證據顯示，NETs透過與慢性發炎、免疫調節、凝血及腫瘤進展的交互作用，參與大腸直腸癌（CRC）的發展。然而，其生物效應在不同疾病情境下有所差異，且CRC特有的調控機轉尚未完全釐清。本綜述檢視NETs在CRC不同階段的角色，包括從發炎到癌症的轉變、原發腫瘤生長、轉移擴散、治療抗藥性及CRC相關併發症。我們討論了涉及腫瘤衍生趨化因子、基質細胞、微生物菌叢失衡、致癌訊號及ROS依賴路徑的CRC相關NET形成機轉。現有證據也顯示NETs並非一致地促進腫瘤生成。因此我們描述了一種「矛盾交會」現象，其效應取決於腫瘤基因型、嗜中性球表現型、免疫情境及誘發NET形成的刺激物。此外，我們回顧了NET相關生物標記、偵測方法及治療策略，同時考量其臨床應用及CRC情境特異性治療所需的證據。

papers.title: Integrated single-cell and bulk tissue analyses reveal distinct macrophage subtypes and a candidate prognostic signature in colorectal cancer: implications for tumor immune characterization
papers.authors: Chen H, Li Z, Lin Z, Wan L, Gong Y, Lv Z
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Colorectal cancer (CRC) represents a major global health burden, marked by high morbidity and mortality rates that place a considerable strain on healthcare systems.
METHODS: This study leveraged integrated bioinformatic analyses, single-cell RNA sequencing, and clinical sample validation to investigate the role of macrophage-related genes (MRGs) in CRC, with the goal of deepening our understanding of the complex interplay within the tumor microenvironment.
RESULTS: Differential expression analysis comparing CRC tumor and normal tissues in the TCGA-COADREAD cohort identified 1,962 differentially expressed genes (DEGs). In parallel, a predefined set of 1,719 MRGs was curated from public databases and the literature to define the macrophage-related biological context. By integrating the bulk transcriptomic DEGs, single-cell macrophage subtype-specific genes, and the predefined MRG set, we identified eight hub macrophage-related DEGs (MRDEGs) implicated in CRC. Functional enrichment analysis of these eight MRDEGs revealed significant roles in immune-regulatory processes, including leukocyte chemotaxis, eosinophil chemotaxis, chemokine receptor binding, and the chemokine signaling pathway. From these eight hub MRDEGs, we selected CCL24 and MMP12 via LASSO-Cox regression to construct a prognostic risk model. Immune infiltration analysis using CIBERSORT revealed significant differences (p < 0.05) in the abundance of nine immune cell types (including M0/M2 Macrophages, CD8+ T cells, T follicular helper cells, regulatory T cells (Tregs), memory B cells, monocytes, eosinophils, and neutrophils) between the risk groups defined by this macrophage-related signature. Drug sensitivity analysis further revealed that the high-risk group was significantly less responsive to sorafenib (p < 0.05). The model provides candidate molecular clues for further investigation of the CRC immune microenvironment and prognostic stratification related to macrophage biology. We further performed experimental validation of the differentially expressed genes using clinical CRC samples and assessed their expression at both the transcriptional and protein levels.
DISCUSSION: This study provides a candidate prognostic stratification model that requires further validation in independent cohorts and prospective studies, offering a macrophage-related prognostic clue for future investigations.

papers.authors: Zhang Y, Wang N, Zheng W, Liu R, Li L, Zhao X
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: With the expanding use of therapeutic monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), there is a critical need for robust, multiplex analytical tools to support therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) and pharmacokinetic studies. This study aimed to develop and validate a rapid and sensitive liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) method for the simultaneous quantification of infliximab (IFX), vedolizumab (VDZ), and ustekinumab (UST) in human serum.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: A universal immunocapture strategy utilizing Protein G magnetic beads was used to enrich total IgG from human serum. Samples were subjected to tryptic digestion and analyzed in multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) mode, with rituximab as a full-process internal standard. Method validation was performed in accordance with regulatory guidelines, evaluating linearity, precision, accuracy, selectivity, recovery, matrix effect, and stability. The validated method was subsequently applied to residual serum samples from IBD patients undergoing treatment.
RESULTS: The method demonstrated excellent linearity (R2>0.99) over the concentration ranges of 0.5-100 μg/mL for IFX and UST, and 1-200 μg/mL for VDZ. Total precision ranged from 1.1% to 14.9%, and accuracy ranged from -12.1% to 14.5%. Validation parameters, including selectivity, carryover, recovery, matrix effects, dilution integrity, and stability, were all within acceptable criteria. Analysis of the 37 clinical samples revealed marked inter-individual variability in drug concentrations. However, the absence of key covariates (eg, body weight and dosing history) precluded a formal pharmacokinetic analysis or attribution of this variability to specific clinical factors.
CONCLUSION: The developed LC-MS/MS method provides a practical, specific, and reproducible tool for the multiplex quantification of therapeutic mAbs. Based on a preliminary exploratory study of 37 patient samples, this method demonstrates analytical feasibility and serves as a promising tool for pharmacokinetic research; however, its definitive clinical applicability and readiness for routine TDM require further confirmation through cross-platform comparison, incurred sample reanalysis, and external validation in larger cohorts.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：隨著治療性單株抗體（mAbs）在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中應用日益擴大，迫切需要穩健、多重分析工具以支援治療藥物監測（TDM）與藥物動力學研究。本研究旨在開發並驗證一種快速、靈敏的液相層析串聯質譜法（LC-MS/MS），用於同時定量人類血清中的infliximab（IFX）、vedolizumab（VDZ）與ustekinumab（UST）。患者與方法：採用Protein G磁珠之通用免疫捕獲策略，從人類血清中富集總IgG。樣本經胰蛋白酶消化後，以多重反應監測（MRM）模式進行分析，並以rituximab作為全流程內標。方法驗證依照法規指引進行，評估線性、精密度、準確度、選擇性、回收率、基質效應與穩定性。驗證後之方法隨後應用於接受治療之IBD患者的剩餘血清樣本。結果：該方法在IFX與UST濃度範圍0.5-100 μg/mL、VDZ濃度範圍1-200 μg/mL內展現優異線性（R2>0.99）。總精密度範圍為1.1%至14.9%，準確度範圍為-12.1%至14.5%。驗證參數包括選擇性、殘留、回收率、基質效應、稀釋完整性與穩定性均符合可接受標準。對37份臨床樣本的分析顯示藥物濃度存在明顯個體間差異。然而，由於缺乏關鍵共變量（如體重與給藥紀錄），無法進行正式藥物動力學分析或將此變異歸因於特定臨床因素。結論：所開發之LC-MS/MS方法提供了一種實用、specific且可重現的多重定量治療性單株抗體工具。基於37份患者樣本之初步探索性研究，此方法展現分析可行性，可作為藥物動力學研究之有潛力工具；然而，其確切臨床適用性與常規TDM之準備程度，仍需透過跨平台比較、incurred sample reanalysis及更大規模世代之外部驗證進一步確認。

papers.title: Beyond total operative time: phase-specific robotic efficiency and postoperative morbidity following colorectal resection - a multisurgeon cohort study
papers.authors: Amin M, Abosheisha M, Salama M, Lim M
papers.abstract: Robotic colorectal surgery is associated with longer operative times than conventional laparoscopic approaches, yet total operative duration is a composite measure comprising fundamentally different procedural components. It remains unknown as to whether postoperative morbidity is attributable to overall operative length or to specific phases of the robotic procedure. A retrospective single-centre cohort study at York and Scarborough NHS Foundation Trust, UK, included consecutive robotic colorectal resections performed by eight consultant surgeons (Surgeons A-H). Two prespecified cohorts were analysed: Cohort A (primary, N = 490) with complete knife-to-skin and case-completion timestamps; Cohort B (nested, N = 138) with complete intraoperative phase timestamps across six predefined phases. The primary outcome was a composite comprising prespecified postoperative complications, readmission and return to theatre within 30 days, plus all-cause mortality within 90 days. Multivariable binary logistic regression was used to examine associations with total operative duration; restricted cubic splines were used as an exploratory assessment of functional form. In Cohort A (N = 490), the primary composite endpoint occurred in 113 patients (23.1%). Median total operative time was 354 min (IQR 270-442). On multivariable analysis, each additional 30 min of operative duration was independently associated with increased odds of the composite endpoint (adjusted OR 1.08, 95% CI 1.01-1.17, p = 0.036). Greater within-programme cumulative case experience was associated with lower odds of morbidity (OR 0.82 per 10 additional cases, 95% CI 0.73-0.92, p < 0.001). In Cohort B (N = 138; 41 events), no individual operative phase reached statistical significance in the originally fitted adjusted phase models; these phase-level analyses are exploratory and should not be interpreted as evidence that any individual phase is unrelated to morbidity. A longer total operative duration was independently associated with our composite morbidity endpoints after adjustment for age, within-programme case experience, operating surgeon and procedure type. Within the smaller nested phase-timing cohort, no individual phase revealed a statistically significant independent association. These phase-level findings are exploratory and do not establish whether console or non-console components mediate the association observed with total operative duration.

papers.abstract_zh: 機器手臂大腸直腸手術的手術時間較傳統腹腔鏡手術長，然而總手術時間是由性質截然不同的各個流程組成的複合指標。目前尚不清楚術後併發症是歸因於整體手術時長，還是機器手臂手術中特定階段所致。本研究為英國York and Scarborough NHS Foundation Trust之單中心回溯性世代研究，納入由八位主治醫師（醫師A-H）連續執行之機器手臂大腸直腸切除手術。分析兩個預先設定的世代：世代A（主要分析，N=490）具完整從劃刀至結束案例之時間戳記；世代B（巢狀分析，N=138）具六個預先定義手術階段之完整術中時間戳記。主要結果為複合指標，包含預先設定之術後併發症、30天內再入院與返回手術室，加上90天內全因死亡率。採用多變項二元邏輯迴歸分析與總手術時間之相關性；以限制性立方樣條作為功能形式之探索性評估。在世代A（N=490）中，主要複合終點發生於113名病人（23.1%）。中位總手術時間為354分鐘（IQR 270-442）。多變項分析顯示，每增加30分鐘手術時間，與複合終點勝算增加獨立相關（調整後OR 1.08，95% CI 1.01-1.17，p=0.036）。計畫內累積手術經驗越多，與較低的併發症勝算相關（每增加10例OR 0.82，95% CI 0.73-0.92，p<0.001）。在世代B（N=138；41例事件）中，原始校正階段模型顯示無任何單一手術階段達統計顯著；這些階段層級分析屬探索性，不應解讀為任何個別階段與併發症無關之證據。調整年齡、計畫內手術經驗、主刀醫師與術式類型後，較長的總手術時間與本研究之複合併發症終點獨立相關。在較小的巢狀階段計時世代中，無任何個別階段顯示統計上顯著之獨立相關性。這些階段層級發現屬探索性，並未確立主刀端或非主刀端成分是否為總手術時間與併發症相關性之中介因素。

papers.title: Limited English Proficiency and Self-Reported Lifetime Use of Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests Among Asian Origin Groups in California: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.journal_full: Cancer control : journal of the Moffitt Cancer Center
papers.authors: Tsai M, Coughlin S, Lee A, Lee M, Zhu H, Wang X
papers.abstract:
IntroductionAsian Americans have lower colorectal cancer (CRC) screening rates compared with other racial/ethnic groups in the United States (U.S.). Moreover, individuals with limited English proficiency (LEP) face additional challenges in understanding and accessing healthcare. We examined the association between seven Asian origin groups and lifetime use of CRC screening [home fecal occult blood test (FOBT) and endoscopy], stratified by LEP status.MethodsData from the 2021-2022 California Health Interview Survey were analyzed (n=23,785 respondents aged 50-75 years). Asian origin groups (Chinese, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, South Asian, Vietnamese, Others) and LEP were exposures of interest. Ever having lifetime use of FOBT and endoscopy screening were outcomes of interest. Weighted multivariable logistic regression was performed.ResultsThe highest prevalence of FOBT screening use were observed in Vietnamese respondents with LEP (57.6%); however, the lowest prevalence of FOBT screening use was found among Filipino (16.6%) respondents with LEP (p-value=0.014). In adjusted analysis, Chinese and Filipino with LEP had 50% (OR, 0.50; 95%, 0.28-0.90) and 90% (OR, 0.10; 95%, 0.03-0.27) lower odds of having lifetime FOBT use, respectively. For those without LEP, South Asians had 46% (OR, 0.54; 95%, 0.38-0.77) lower odds of having lifetime FOBT use, and Chinese and Korean had 35% (OR, 0.65; 95%, 0.51-0.84) and 52% (OR, 0.48; 95%, 0.33-0.69) lower odds of having lifetime endoscopy use, respectively.ConclusionFOBT screening disparities are evident among Chinese and Filipino Americans with LEP. These findings highlight the complexity of CRC screening disparities across Asian origin groups and suggest the need for further investigation.
Asian Americans in the United States are less likely to receive recommended colorectal cancer (CRC) screening compared to other racial and ethnic groups. People who have limited English proficiency (LEP) may face additional barriers, such as difficulty understanding healthcare information, communicating with healthcare providers, or navigating the healthcare system. This study examined how CRC screening varies across seven Asian origin groups in California, and whether language proficiency affects screening use. We analyzed data from the 2021–2022 California Health Interview Survey among eligible adults aged 50–75. The study looked at two types of CRC screening: stool-based tests (fecal occult blood test; FOBT) and endoscopy procedures. We compared screening rates across Asian ethnic groups and by whether individuals had LEP. Among individuals with LEP, Vietnamese participants had the highest rate of FOBT screening (57.6%), while Filipino participants had the lowest (16.6%). Further, Chinese individuals with LEP were about 50% less likely, and Filipino individuals with LEP were about 90% less likely, to have received FOBT screening compared to others. Among individuals without LEP, South Asians were less likely to use FOBT, while Chinese and Korean participants were less likely to have undergone endoscopy. Overall, the study highlights significant disparities in CRC screening use among Asian origin groups, especially among those with LEP. These findings suggest that language barriers play an important role in access to preventive healthcare for CRC.

前言：相較於美國其他種族/族裔，亞裔美國人的大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢率較低。此外，英語能力受限（LEP）者在理解與使用醫療資源上面臨額外挑戰。本研究檢視七個亞裔起源族群與終生CRC篩檢使用（居家糞便潛血檢查FOBT及內視鏡）之關聯，並依LEP狀態分層分析。
方法：分析2021-2022年加州健康訪談調查資料（受訪者n=23,785，年齡50-75歲）。暴露變項為亞裔起源族群（華人、菲律賓人、日本人、韓國人、南亞人、越南人、其他）與LEP狀態。結果變項為終生FOBT與內視鏡篩檢使用情形。採用加權多變量邏輯迴歸分析。
結果：LEP越南裔受訪者FOBT篩檢盛行率最高（57.6%）；LEP菲律賓裔受訪者盛行率最低（16.6%）（p值=0.014）。校正分析顯示，LEP華裔與菲律賓裔終生FOBT使用的勝算分別低50%（OR 0.50，95% CI 0.28-0.90）與90%（OR 0.10，95% CI 0.03-0.27）。在無LEP者中，南亞裔終生FOBT使用勝算低46%（OR 0.54，95% CI 0.38-0.77）；華裔與韓裔終生內視鏡使用勝算分別低35%（OR 0.65，95% CI 0.51-0.84）與52%（OR 0.48，95% CI 0.33-0.69）。
結論：FOBT篩檢差異在LEP華裔與菲律賓裔美國人中明顯存在。此發現凸顯亞裔起源族群間CRC篩檢差異的複雜性，建議需進一步研究。

papers.title: Pattern-Based P53 Immunohistochemistry Predicts Recurrence in Colorectal Liver Metastases Without Complete Pathologic Response After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
papers.authors: Ho P, Nguyen D, Hao V, Tran G, Trung L, Van Hoang T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Aberrant p53 expression may have prognostic significance in colorectal cancer; however, its role in patients with colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) who receive neoadjuvant chemotherapy but do not achieve pathological complete response (pCR) remains unclear.
AIMS: We evaluated whether aberrant p53 expression assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC) predicts recurrence-free survival (RFS) in patients with CRLM receiving neoadjuvant FOLFOXIRI followed by resection without achieving pCR.
METHODS AND RESULTS: A prospective cohort study was conducted on 39 patients with CRLM who met the inclusion criteria. All patients received neoadjuvant chemotherapy with the FOLFOXIRI regimen. Following surgical resection of both primary colorectal tumors and liver metastases, none of the patients achieved pCR. Immunohistochemistry was performed to assess p53 expression in resected liver metastasis specimens using a pattern-based interpretation model. RFS was analyzed using univariate and multivariate Cox proportional hazards models. Aberrant p53 expression was observed in 20 patients (51.3%). In univariate analysis, aberrant p53 expression (HR = 2.20; 95% CI: 1.02-4.71; p = 0.043), total tumor size > 6 cm (HR = 5.62; 95% CI: 2.31-13.68; p < 0.001), number of liver metastases > 4 (HR = 4.41; 95% CI: 1.59-12.26; p = 0.004), and positive surgical margin (HR = 2.62; 95% CI: 1.16-5.91; p = 0.021) were significantly associated with recurrence. In multivariate analysis, aberrant p53 expression (HR = 3.78; 95% CI: 1.56-9.15; p = 0.003) and total tumor size > 6 cm (HR = 5.23; 95% CI: 1.56-17.55; p = 0.007) remained independent prognostic factors for shorter RFS.cnr270701_RedLinePDF.
CONCLUSION: Aberrant p53 expression, as assessed by immunohistochemistry on post-neoadjuvant chemotherapy specimens, is an independent prognostic factor for early recurrence in patients with CRLM who did not achieve pCR. Together with total tumor size, aberrant p53 expression may serve as a useful marker for risk stratification and personalized postoperative treatment strategies in this high-risk patient population.

papers.title_zh: 新輔助化療後未達病理完全反應之大腸直腸癌肝轉移患者：基於型態之P53免疫組織化學染色可預測復發
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：異常p53表現可能在大腸直腸癌中具預後意義；然而，在接受新輔助化療但未達病理完全反應（pCR）之大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）患者中，其角色尚不明確。目的：我們評估以免疫組織化學（IHC）評估之異常p53表現，是否能預測接受新輔助FOLFOXIRI化療後手術切除但未達pCR之CRLM患者的無復發存活（RFS）。方法與結果：本前瞻性世代研究納入39名符合條件之CRLM患者，所有患者均接受FOLFOXIRI新輔助化療方案。於原發大腸直腸腫瘤及肝轉移病灶手術切除後，無一患者達到pCR。對切除之肝轉移標本以基於型態之判讀模式進行p53表現IHC評估。使用單變量及多變量Cox比例風險模型分析RFS。20名患者（51.3%）出現異常p53表現。單變量分析顯示，異常p53表現（HR = 2.20；95% CI：1.02-4.71；p = 0.043）、腫瘤總大小>6公分（HR = 5.62；95% CI：2.31-13.68；p < 0.001）、肝轉移數目>4個（HR = 4.41；95% CI：1.59-12.26；p = 0.004）及手術邊緣陽性（HR = 2.62；95% CI：1.16-5.91；p = 0.021）均與復發顯著相關。多變量分析中，異常p53表現（HR = 3.78；95% CI：1.56-9.15；p = 0.003）及腫瘤總大小>6公分（HR = 5.23；95% CI：1.56-17.55；p = 0.007）仍為RFS較短之獨立預後因子。結論：以免疫組織化學評估新輔助化療後標本之異常p53表現，是未達pCR之CRLM患者早期復發的獨立預後因子。異常p53表現連同腫瘤總大小，可能作為此高風險患者群風險分層及個人化術後治療策略之有用標記。
